target.reason: Istanbul is pre-Paris and accepted by every supported solc, so the version axis shows both the pre-0.8.18 error and the warning-only behaviour after it.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: This is the case the test is about: once `block.prevrandao` exists, solc downgrades the pre-Paris use to a warning that it 'is not supported by the VM version and will be treated as "difficulty"'. Slang keeps `block.prevrandao` available on every target without a diagnostic, so it stays silent where solc warns.
